title: Test case 4 — A single punch in a taxi queue (manslaughter; the 10-year minimum non-parole period)
shows: A mandatory minimum that turns on facts the form asks for: the offence was after 1 November 2014, the manslaughter was committed by a single punch or strike (admitted) and the prosecution gave notice, so the non-parole period must be at least 10 years unless a special reason is found; manslaughter is also a Category 2 offence, so imprisonment without a CCO unless an exception is established. Intoxication by liquor contributed, so the hard checks require the alcohol exclusion order (manslaughter is a relevant offence).
